title: Analysis Mode killed half the Excel exports on your client's shared drive
summary: Analysis Mode is a feature that lets users group, filter, and pivot data on Business Central list pages without exporting to Excel. It creates personal analysis views with their own columns, filters, and arrangements that persist between sessions and can be packaged into extensions.
key_points: Analysis views let users organize data by grouping, filtering, and pivoting without changing underlying data or affecting other users
Date hierarchies automatically generate Year, Quarter, and Month fields for grouping, but use calendar years not fiscal years
Requires execute permission on system object 9640; check the DATA ANALYSIS - EXEC permission set if the button is missing
Analysis mode can be disabled per page with the AnalysisModeEnabled property and is not supported on indented lists like Chart of Accounts
Analysis definitions can be exported as JSON and packaged into extensions for distribution to clients

quotes.text: Nothing you do here touches the underlying data, and nothing you do changes the page for anyone else.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the safety and isolation of analysis mode operations for nervous users

quotes.text: Date hierarchies use the calendar year. Not your client's fiscal year.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical limitation when fiscal year differs from calendar year; causes reporting discrepancies
